response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished senior software engineer with 14+ years of experience exceeding the 8+ year requirement, his background is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core technical focus. This position requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture design, and hardware optimization—specialized domains requiring hardware engineering knowledge. Bogdan's entire career has been in application-level software development (web, mobile, backend services). His recent AI infrastructure work lacks the specific expertise in deep learning workload analysis and AI accelerator optimization that the role demands. The required foundation in hardware-software co-design for performance optimization is absent.
strengths: Meets seniority requirement with 14+ years of technical experience and current staff-level position, exceeding the 8+ year threshold for bachelor's degree holders
Demonstrated expertise in performance optimization and low-latency systems, including microservices handling millions of requests and sophisticated caching strategies
Shows emerging interest in AI infrastructure through current role at re:cinq, indicating some awareness of advanced technical domains
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling or System-on-Chip design—the primary technical focus of this principal architect role
Career entirely in application software development with no background in GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD design, or hardware optimization fundamentals
Missing critical expertise in deep neural network training/inference optimization and AI accelerator workload analysis—a key responsibility

key_factors.factor: SoC/IP Modeling and Hardware Design Experience
GPU Architecture and AI Accelerator Expertise
Senior-Level Technical Seniority and Track Record
